03 03 · Process

From first call to live system

A tight, transparent process — you always know what's happening, what's next, and what it costs.

01

Discover

Week 1

A working session to map your goals, tools, and bottlenecks. You get a scoped plan with fixed pricing — no surprises later.

02

Design

Week 2

Wireframes, agent blueprints, and automation maps — reviewed and approved by you before a single line is built.

03

Build

Weeks 3–5

We build, integrate, and test in weekly sprints. You see real progress every Friday — not a big reveal at the end.

04

Scale

Ongoing

Launch, handover docs, and team training — then ongoing support and optimization as your business grows.

05 05 · FAQ

Questions, answered

The things every client asks before we start. Something else on your mind? Just ask.

Most automations and AI agents ship in 2–4 weeks; websites in 3–6 weeks. You'll get a fixed timeline before we start — and weekly demos while we build, so there are no surprises.

Yes. We integrate with 100+ platforms — CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce, spreadsheets, ERPs, ad platforms, and anything with an API. If a tool doesn't have one, we usually still find a way.

Running costs are typically a small monthly fraction of the build — mostly API usage that scales with volume. We estimate it upfront and design agents to stay efficient as you grow.

You do — 100%. Code, automations, agent training data, and documentation are handed over with full admin access. No lock-in, ever.

Every project includes 30 days of free support. After that, most clients move to a care plan or retainer so we keep improving the system as your business grows.

Absolutely. We regularly rescue stalled builds and messy automations — starting with an audit so we fix the foundation, not just the symptoms.
